documents.title: Guidelines on the Use of Generative AI in Curriculum
documents.stance_why: The document offers three syllabus tiers (prohibited, permitted with disclosure, permitted with limitations) and says it gives "faculty the freedom to set course policies", so the stance is delegates with tiers, even though it also says "Any use of GAI is only acceptable if clearly established by the course instructor."
tiers: Option 1: Prohibited - No Use of GAI
Option 2: Permitted with Full Disclosure and Reflection
documents.summary: Faculty Senate guidelines for LSU A&M that set shared obligations, permitted and prohibited uses for students and faculty, and offer three syllabus template options. Instructors decide course policy, with a default that AI use is acceptable only if the instructor clearly establishes it. Misuse is routed to Student Advocacy & Accountability, and detectors may not be the sole basis for penalties.
